# Al Maghseel Central Air Conditioner Est.

> Air conditioning (HVAC) business based in Al Ain, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, established in 2006. Supplies and installs new A/C systems and repairs and maintains existing split and central A/C for homes, villas, shops and workplaces.

Arabic name: مؤسسة المغسيل للمكيفات المركزية

## Key facts

- Business type: A/C supply, installation, repair and maintenance (HVAC contractor)
- Established: 2006
- Address: 32 Al Wakalat 7 St, Industrial Area, Al Aras, Al Ain, Abu Dhabi, UAE
- Phone: +971 50 673 4821 (050 673 4821 within the UAE)
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/message/KFSOXCXKJFEDD1
- Email: service@almaghseel.com
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/d7yFxW5A99gehHrK7
- Languages: Arabic and English
- Service area: based in Al Ain; requests are accepted from Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Umm Al Quwain and Fujairah, with visit availability confirmed by location before dispatch
- Customers: residential, commercial and industrial
- Pricing: quoted after the team confirms the scope; the website does not publish fixed prices

## Services

- [AC repair in Al Ain](https://www.almaghseel.com/ac-repair-al-ain/): diagnosis and repair when an A/C is not cooling, leaking water, noisy or tripping; refrigerant leak testing and refill; compressor, PCB, capacitor, contactor, fan motor, thermostat and sensor faults
- [AC maintenance and cleaning in Al Ain](https://www.almaghseel.com/ac-maintenance-al-ain/): cleaning and inspection of filters, condenser coils, drain lines, fans and electrical parts; scheduled support for homes and commercial properties
- [AC supply and installation in Al Ain](https://www.almaghseel.com/ac-installation-al-ain/): supply of a suitable split or central unit, mounting, copper and drainage piping, wiring, testing and commissioning

## How to book

Call or send a WhatsApp message with your area, building type, A/C type and what the unit is doing. The team confirms availability and a visit window for the location. The technician inspects first and explains the recommended repair before major work.
